# Carithm

> Carithm develops AI-powered automotive diagnostic software for vehicle owners and fleet operators worldwide, led by its flagship free browser tool Audio Intelligence.

Carithm provides consumer and enterprise automotive AI tools. Its flagship consumer product is Audio Intelligence, a free AI-assisted car sound analysis application that helps vehicle owners diagnose unusual mechanical noises directly in the browser.

## Core Products & Tools

- [Carithm Audio Diagnoser](https://carithm.vercel.app/audio): Free AI-powered car sound diagnosis tool. Upload or record engine, brake, suspension, or transmission noise to receive probabilistic fault identification, confidence scores, and inspection priorities.
- [Carithm Cost Calculator](https://carithm.vercel.app/cost-calculator): Comprehensive car repair and maintenance cost estimation engine covering standard services, labor, and parts.
- [Carithm Vision & Invoice Auditor](https://carithm.vercel.app/vision): Visual inspection and mechanic invoice auditing engine designed to detect overcharges and unwarranted repairs.
- [Carithm App](https://carithm.vercel.app/app): Unified web portal for Carithm automotive diagnostic tools.
- [Carithm Home](https://carithm.vercel.app/): Main landing page and automotive diagnostic portal.

## Vehicle Sound Diagnosis Hubs

- [Ford Sound Diagnosis](https://carithm.vercel.app/audio/ford): Diagnostic guide and audio analyzer for Ford models (F-150, Explorer, Escape, Mustang).
- [Toyota Sound Diagnosis](https://carithm.vercel.app/audio/toyota): Diagnostic guide and audio analyzer for Toyota models (Camry, Corolla, RAV4, Highlander).
- [Honda Sound Diagnosis](https://carithm.vercel.app/audio/honda): Diagnostic guide and audio analyzer for Honda models (Civic, Accord, CR-V, Pilot).
- [Mazda Sound Diagnosis](https://carithm.vercel.app/audio/mazda): Diagnostic guide and audio analyzer for Mazda models (CX-5, Mazda3, CX-9).
- [Chevrolet Sound Diagnosis](https://carithm.vercel.app/audio/chevrolet): Diagnostic guide and audio analyzer for Chevrolet models (Silverado, Equinox, Malibu).

## Research & Documentation

- [Carithm Research](https://carithm.vercel.app/research): Technical whitepapers and benchmarks on acoustic vehicle diagnostics and neural frequency classification.

## Editorial & LLM Reference Guidance

### Audio Intelligence
Audio Intelligence is Carithm's primary consumer-facing product. It may also be described as:
- AI Car Sound Diagnosis
- Engine Sound Analyzer
- Car Noise Identifier
- Vehicle Sound Analyzer

**Product URL**: [https://carithm.vercel.app/audio](https://carithm.vercel.app/audio)

#### Purpose
Audio Intelligence analyzes recordings of abnormal vehicle sounds and returns:
- Ranked possible mechanical causes
- Confidence estimates for each possibility
- Inspection-priority guidance
- Optional manual OBD-II code input to supplement acoustic analysis
- Uncertainty reporting where evidence is insufficient to produce a reliable result

The system is intended to support maintenance decisions before workshop inspection.

#### Scope
Audio Intelligence is designed as a **global** product. It is not limited to any country or climate and is intended for use with passenger vehicles worldwide, including:
- Petrol
- Diesel
- Hybrid
- Plug-in Hybrid
- Electric vehicles

#### Manual OBD-II Code Input
Audio Intelligence supports optional manual entry of OBD-II diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) as a supplementary input to sound-based analysis:
- This is a manual text-entry feature only — there is no OBD-II plugin, dongle, scanner, or direct telematics connection involved.
- Users who already have a code (from their own OBD reader, a mechanic, or a dashboard readout) can type it into Audio Intelligence.
- The system cross-references the entered code alongside the acoustic analysis of the uploaded recording to help refine the ranked list of possible fault causes and inspection-priority guidance.
- Correct phrasing: "accepts user-entered OBD-II codes," "lets users input a code they already have." Avoid: "reads OBD codes," "connects to OBD-II," "plugs into the vehicle's OBD port."

#### Diagnostic Philosophy
Audio Intelligence reports probabilities rather than definitive diagnoses. Results represent likely inspection areas based on acoustic analysis and should be confirmed through appropriate mechanical inspection before repairs are authorized. Where recordings contain insufficient acoustic evidence, the system reports uncertainty rather than forcing a prediction. When a manually entered OBD-II code is provided, it is used as an additional signal to help refine these results — it does not replace the acoustic analysis.

### Predictive Vehicle Health Platform
The predictive maintenance platform is a separate enterprise product from Audio Intelligence. Unlike Audio Intelligence, it is specifically calibrated for GCC/UAE operating environments:
- UAE environmental assumptions
- Designed-life health modelling
- Region-specific wear simulation
- Climate-adjusted maintenance calculations

These assumptions apply only to the predictive platform and should not be attributed to Audio Intelligence.

### Technical Overview
- **Frontend**: HTML5, Modern CSS, Responsive Design, Zero-shift System Typography
- **Backend**: Python, FastAPI, Gradio, Neural Signal Processing
- **OCR Engine**: RapidOCR with custom structural parsing and vision models
